newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: CREDITANSTALT TO OPEN REPRESENTATIVE OFFICE.
newsitem.headline: CREDITANSTALT TO OPEN REPRESENTATIVE OFFICE.

text.p: Austria's Creditanstalt Investment Bank will open a representative office in Lithuania in the next few months, the business newspaper Verslo Zinios reported on Monday.

"Lithuania was chosen for the representative office because it has the largest potential for investments, and the liquidity of the securities market should grow," Creditanstalt's Baltic representative Tomas Marcinkus was quoted as saying in the newspaper.

Together with Vilfima brokers, Creditanstalt representatives visited ten Lithuanian companies, including Utenos Beverages, Medienos Plaushas, Sanitas, Nemunas, Ekranas, Vilniaus Tauras, and Lithuanian Gas, the newspaper reported.
Creditanstalt is carrying out an analysis of Baltic capital markets and will present the results at the June 4-5 Stockholm conference on Baltic capital markets, the newspaper said.
Creditanstalt is on the short list of candidates to act as lead adviser in the Lithuanian Telecom privatisation, Verslo Zinios reported.
